changeSet.sql: UPDATE player_badge_showcase s SET selected_badge_id = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE s.selected_badge_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM player_achievements pa JOIN achievement_definitions ad ON ad.id = pa.achievement_id WHERE pa.player_id = s.player_id AND ad.key = s.selected_badge_id );

rollback.comment: Not reversible: the cleared selections were unearned and are not retained.

changeSet.sql: COMMENT ON COLUMN player_badge_showcase.selected_badge_id IS 'achievement_definitions.key of the badge shown on the profile. Must be one the player has unlocked; BadgeService enforces this on write.';
